Synopsis:
This Fist is standing guard at the gate that leads to basilisk gate barracks. He is balancing on one leg as punishment for stealing something from the evidence room. His right leg is raised.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_BasiliskGate_GateGuard.json: A Flaming Fist soldier stands guard at the gate to the Basilisk Gate barracks, publicly balancing on his right leg as a penance for stealing from the evidence room. He admits to having taken a purse and says he’s doing the one‑leg punishment until Blaze Portyr (a superior/officer he answers to) believes he’s reformed. This is a low‑level disciplinary measure within the Flaming Fist amid an environment where soldiers are on edge and stern order‑keeping is common. The player’s replies can vary from mocking or playful (pretend to push him) to moralizing or scolding, which changes the tone of the exchange.
- LOW_BasiliskGate_Sentinel_AD_WithGateGuard.json: Fist Murphy is being punished for stealing a purse full of coin from the evidence room. He's being made to stand on one leg as punishment. Fist Clover occasionally comes to check up on him. Murphy is mortified, sore, and wishes the punishment was over. Clover has sympathy for him but also thinks he was a big dumb idiot.
- LOW_BasiliskGate_DoorGuard.json: This random Fist is standing by the door to Flaming Fist HQ. As opposed to the shame spot at the gate this is an honor spot basically employee of the moth reward. He has some reactions to execution of Florrick. Turns out he's extremely lawful.. and awful.
- LOW_BasiliskGate_Executioner.json: A Flaming Fist soldier (Fist "Edge" Arensen) is posted on the gallows in the Lower City, loudly threatening that cultists, thieves and other troublemakers will be hanged — he’s stern, brutal, and enforcing order. Off‑screen, the player has just tampered with a nearby windmill, which flung a small gnome and drew a pack of goblins (led by Fezzerk and scouts) away to investigate, so the city is already on edge. In some variations the player is also carrying the Moonlantern/pixie, weighing whether to keep its protection or free it; either way, the player’s replies range from defiant taunts to placating compliance. Edge’s line functions as a generic Flaming Fist warning used by patrolling guards around the Audience Hall and Lower City.
- LOW_BasiliskGate_Sergeant.json: One-liner dialog for one of the idling Flaming Fist officers at the barracks near the Basilisk Gate.

context: Fist Murphy is a Flaming Fist soldier posted at the gate to the Basilisk Gate barracks, publicly balancing on his right leg as a low‑level disciplinary penance for stealing from the evidence room. He admits he took a purse and says he must keep the one‑leg punishment until his superior, Blaze Portyr, believes he’s reformed. Off‑screen Fist Clover occasionally checks on him; Murphy is mortified, sore, and eager for the punishment to end, while the barracks atmosphere is tense and strict about order. The player’s replies can range from mocking or playful to moralizing or scolding, which changes the tone of the exchange.
